newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 9.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Tony Bullimore, the British yachtsman who had been given up for dead, was rescued by the Australian Maritime Safety Authority after spending five days sheltering in an air pocket in the upturned hull of his wrecked boat, in freezing ocean.
GAS ATTACKED OVER NORTH SEA SAVINGS

Sue Slipman, director of the Gas Consumers' Council, has criticised British Gas for not saying when customers will share in the savings stemming from the renegotiation of billions of pounds worth of contracts with North Sea producers. Slipman says she may raise the issue with the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
LLOYD'S "SET TO CHALK UP RECORD PROFITS'

The insurance analysts Chatset have predicted that Lloyd's of London is about to report the best annual profits in its 300-year history. The analysts have forecast a bottom line profit of 1.177 billion pounds for 1994, against 1.172 billion in 1993.
GILLETTE STAYS KEEN WITH TACTICS SWITCH
Gillette's latest advertising campaign aims to get hard-core users of its disposable razors to abandon them in favour of its more profitable, refillable SensorExcel.
